name: MultiCorrupt
description: MultiCorrupt is a benchmark for evaluating the robustness of multi-modal 3D object detection systems used in autonomous driving, especially LiDAR-camera fusion models, under sensor corruption, misalignment, and adverse weather conditions.
evaluation_method: 3D object detection performance under corruption and shift, typically reported with detection metrics such as mAP / NDS on corrupted conditions and compared against clean-condition baselines.
typical_sota_score: ≈60–80% on clean conditions (mAP/NDS), with substantial drops under corruption depending on corruption type
notes: Focuses on real-world failure modes for sensor fusion: temporal/spatial misalignment, calibration errors, and weather-induced corruption. Exact score scale depends on the underlying detector and corruption protocol.
